options.label: Graphics backend
options.description: How xemu draws the game. Vulkan is usually the faster one on this device.

options.label: Internal resolution
options.description: Draws the game at a multiple of the Xbox's resolution for a sharper picture. Higher costs speed.

options.label: Aspect ratio
options.description: The shape of the picture. Game's own follows the game's widescreen setting (4:3 or 16:9).

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: How the picture is scaled up to the screen. Sharp keeps pixels crisp; Smooth blends them.

options.label: VSync
options.description: Waits for the screen's refresh to stop tearing. Can add a little input lag.

notes: Verified against xemu v0.8.136 (fc24584) config_spec.yml:226-286 and genconfig 42f85f9 (subprojects/genconfig.wrap). Tables/keys: [display] renderer enum NULL|OPENGL|VULKAN, [display.quality] surface_scale integer (default 1), [display] filtering enum linear|nearest, [display.window] vsync bool (default true), [display.ui] fit enum center|scale|stretch (default scale), [display.ui] aspect_ratio enum native|auto|4x3|16x9 (default auto).

Enum strings are matched exactly, case-sensitive (genconfig cnode.h:133-138 std::find); an unknown string or a wrong TOML type is reported and the default kept (cnode.h:213-218, 331-338). So renderer is 'VULKAN'/'OPENGL' and surface_scale a bare TOML integer.

Vulkan is built when the vulkan dependency is found (meson.build:2387-2396); the official aarch64 AppImage has it (our seed already selects it). A renderer the build lacks falls back to the default (hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/pgraph.c:254-273). No software renderer exists.
surface_scale is read when the renderer starts (hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/vk/surface.c:73-77, gl/surface.c:75-79); xemu's menu offers 1x-10x (ui/xui/main-menu.cc:751-764). We offer 1x-4x.

Aspect: with fit=scale the picture keeps aspect_ratio (auto = 16:9 when the game's widescreen flag is set, else 4:3); fit=stretch fills the screen and ignores aspect_ratio (ui/xui/gl-helpers.cc:928-976). Every choice writes both keys, so an earlier 'center' display mode is replaced by 'scale'.

integer_scale left out: fit=center draws the frame 1:1 at its own height, centred, never scaled to an integer multiple (ui/xui/gl-helpers.cc:958-962). show_fps and widescreen_hack left out: no such keys in config_spec.yml.

filtering sets the display texture's GL min/mag filter (ui/xui/gl-helpers.cc:892-901). vsync sets the GL swap interval of xemu's window, which also presents the Vulkan renderer's frames (ui/xemu.c:1095, ui/xui/main.cc:330-332).
xemu rewrites xemu.toml at exit with its non-default values only; restore after the run puts our line back as it was. A TOML error makes xemu exit 1, so emuopts validates the TOML it writes.
